title: bash: fiori: command not found when running the deploy command directly
symptom:
Running this straight in a terminal:

  npm run build && fiori deploy --config ui5-deploy.yaml --verbose

The build completes, then it stops at:

  bash: fiori: command not found
rootCause: `fiori` is a local binary installed by @sap/ux-ui5-tooling into node_modules/.bin, not on the system PATH. Only npm scripts add node_modules/.bin to PATH when they run.

solutions.label: Use npx
solutions.body: npm run build && npx fiori deploy --config ui5-deploy.yaml --verbose

solutions.label: Add a script to package.json
solutions.body:
"deploy-verbose": "npm run build && fiori deploy --config ui5-deploy.yaml --verbose"

Then just: npm run deploy-verbose

prevention: Route every project-binary command through an npm script or npx. Do not install @sap/ux-ui5-tooling globally — it drifts out of sync across team machines.
